mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear near Verona City Hall with a current temperature of 74 degrees and an air quality index of 51. The moon is in its first quarter phase, and the space station will be visible starting at 3:23 AM, traveling from Belleville toward Fitchburg while staying low on the horizon. There is a busy schedule ahead! Today, you can attend UGM at Epic, Yoga at Insight Wellness, Concerts in the Park, or Hop Haus Trivia. Tomorrow, look forward to live music at Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
